title: Terrain canonical field-grid and collision join follow-up, ACNH 1.0.0

build.address_convention: Native ELF virtual addresses (VA); raw callsite bytes are little-endian AArch64.

scope.question: Do LandMaking source-cell transfer and Island Designer placement/editor mutations reach the runtime field ground/collision grid and an apply/save path?
scope.method: Static inspection of main.elf bytes, the existing native_functions/direct_calls SQLite index, relocated code_pointer_arrays.json, indexed BYML/BCSV inventory, save_layout.json, and prior terrain/editor ledgers. No game run, save mutation, index edit, or Godot change.
scope.conclusion: One state-gated world-context handler writes directly to the 52-byte base ground grid through 0x163780/0x163760 wrappers. No static edge joins the 14-byte LandMaking loader or Island Designer scratch result to these canonical-grid writers, and no grid apply/save serializer is identified; those joins remain OPEN.

landmaking_preset_manifest.digest_method: SHA256 of compact sorted-key JSON array from files(source,format,size,sha256,raw_path,raw_bytes_verified); rows below preserve each indexed source SHA256.

main_text_segment.instruction_scan_basis: existing direct_calls index; aligned immediate AArch64 call/branch-to-entry records

index_bounds.pointer_array_scan: All entries in the existing relocated-code-pointer sequence corpus; each row carries generic status and is not automatically a C++ vtable.
index_bounds.save_layout_scan: Current save_layout.json output is a depth-2 view; name search only bounds that emitted representation.

function_slices.hash_basis: SHA256 over exact main.elf bytes at native_functions VA and indexed size.

landmaking_source_cell.destination: seven fields written through separate LandMaking cell accessor at offsets 0,2,4,6,8,10,12; not the 52-byte ground record

runtime_ground_grid.query: 0x172740; base/overlay selection depends on mode and overlay attribute sentinel 7

structures.grid_identity_boundary: The handler fetches [loaded context+0xa0] after passing context+0x28 through wrappers that load +0x78. This matches the slot arithmetic of other grid paths; pointer identity with the object constructed by 0x156e30 is not proven.

edges.effect: Wrapper loads owner+0x78 and branches to base ground attribute writer 0x185960.
Tail branch after owner+0x78; 0x185960 writes four base-record attribute bytes.
Wrapper loads owner+0x78 and branches to base ground float writer 0x185800.
Tail branch after owner+0x78; 0x185800 writes twelve base-record float fields.
Owner+0x78 overlay wrapper; guarded null pointer; copies base floats to overlay and fills four overlay attributes.
Owner+0x78 flag-region wrapper; updates region flag bit 2.
Ground scalar query invokes grid callback in base mode.
Preset setup passes LandMaking resource and destination cell grid to the 14-byte loader.
Saved preset UID is wrapped and sent to LandMaking preset reload.
Copies 3x3 patch into caller-local stack buffer at sp+0x80; does not pass the buffer onward.

rectangle_setup.effect: selects componentwise min/max endpoint values into region record

world_slot_expression.identity_status: slot arithmetic is observed; singleton/pointer identity with the 0x156e30-created grid remains OPEN

pointer_array_evidence.status: relocated code pointer sequence; not automatically a C++ vtable

world_context_base_writer.interpretation_limit: The indexed direct-call rows have owner_va null because 0x8445d0 lacks a functions-table entry; raw bytes establish the local caller body. Pointer sequence membership does not identify dispatcher or prove this state branch ran.

overlay_collision_path.record_effect: copies 12 base float32 fields to overlay record; writes argument to overlay attr bytes +0x30..+0x33
overlay_collision_path.query_selection: Mode bit0 forces base; otherwise valid overlay record is used when the selected attribute is not sentinel 7.
overlay_collision_path.island_designer_join: OPEN; no editor scratch/result path found to these overlay callers.

callback_vtable_pointer_evidence.status: relocated code pointer sequence; not automatically a C++ vtable

ground_query_path.known_consumers: terrain height/status and candidate-query paths; no direct editor result edge found in the bounded editor call graph.

island_designer_path.actionparam: FieldLandMakingActionParam BCSV, 17 rows, 40-byte row stride; resolved ActionRange/Layer/SuccessResult/enum fields feed validator and local work builders.
island_designer_path.scratch: 0x53e4f0 and descendants use four 12x12 layers, 0x240-byte layer stride, 32-bit cells.

open_joins.reason: The 3x3 buffer is local to 0x531ad0 and no bounded call graph edge reaches writer/query targets.

limits: Static RE only; no game runtime state or save object was loaded.
Direct-call and pointer-array negatives are bounded to the supplied index/corpus and do not exclude indirect calls outside that corpus.
The pointer-array tool labels sequences generically; no C++ vtable claim is made for 0x308ce28.
The generated save-layout view is depth-limited and name search cannot exclude hashed/binary fields.
No Godot files, source indexes, or crosswalks were changed.
artifact_policy: Requested documentation and JSON only; no staging, commit, or push.
